title: Specialization in Software Engineering
description: Specialization focused on software development methodologies. During the course, I deepened my knowledge in requirements engineering, software modeling, project management, and systems development. As a final project, I developed a complete system for registering and managing the street markets of the city of Curitiba, covering all stages of the software project life cycle.
text:
The Universidade Federal do Paraná(UFPR) is the oldest public university in Brazil, founded on December 19, 1912, initially under the name Universidade do Paraná. Located in Curitiba, UFPR is a symbol of Paraná's intellectual life and plays a fundamental role in higher education in the state and the country.

UFPR offers a wide range of undergraduate, graduate, specialization, master’s, doctoral, technical, and distance education programs. The institution is based on the inseparable tripod of Teaching, Research, and Extension, always striving for academic excellence and contributing to social and scientific development (ufpr.br).

With campuses in several cities of Paraná—including Curitiba, Pontal do Paraná, Matinhos, Jandaia do Sul, Toledo, and Palotina—UFPR is present throughout the state, promoting higher education and regional development (ufpr.br).

UFPR’s mission is to produce, disseminate, foster, and apply knowledge, contributing to building an inclusive, equitable, and supportive society and to sustainable development. Its vision is to consolidate and expand its status as a university of international significance in Teaching, Research, Extension, and Innovation, supporting scientific and cultural initiatives aimed at promoting citizenship and national sovereignty (ufpr.br).

UFPR is also recognized for its academic and scientific excellence. It ranks among the best universities in Brazil and appears in international rankings, especially in areas such as Physics, Chemistry, Law, and Economic Development (Wikipedia).

The historic UFPR headquarters, located at Santos Andrade Square in Curitiba, is an architectural icon of the city. The building, inaugurated in 1915 and expanded over the years, is an example of neoclassical style and symbolizes the tradition and importance of the university to Paraná’s culture (Wikipedia).

In summary, the Universidade Federal do Paranáis a nationally and internationally prominent institution of higher education, committed to academic excellence, scientific research, and community engagement, playing a crucial role in Brazil's educational and social development.

title: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science
description: A course with a strong foundation in computational logic and algorithmic structures. The degree provides a solid base for understanding and developing algorithms, covering fundamental concepts to advanced topics. The curriculum includes algorithms, mathematics, statistics, asymptotic analysis, induction, graph theory, artificial intelligence, compilers, and more. Throughout the program, different levels of coding and abstraction are explored, preparing students to face complex challenges in computer science.

title: UFPR Technical School
description: High school education completed at the Professional and Technological Education Sector of the Universidade Federal do Paraná(UFPR). A recognized institution for its excellence in secondary education and its highly competitive selection process. Along with the standard national curriculum, I took complementary modules in Computing, Financial Mathematics, and Spanish (over three years).
text:
The Technical School of the Universidade Federal do Paraná(UFPR), located in the Jardim das Américas neighborhood of Curitiba, is a professional education institution affiliated with UFPR. Since its administrative reorganization in 1990, it has offered secondary and higher-level technical courses focused on training qualified professionals for the job market.
The UFPR Technical School stands out for its teaching quality, modern infrastructure, and partnerships with public and private institutions, providing students with a solid education aligned with market demands.

title: French Course
description: Comprehensive French course focused on language and interculturality. Training was conducted at a school specializing in French language instruction, with a program integrating language learning and cultural aspects. I completed all levels offered by the institution, developing reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills.
text:
Celin – the Center for Languages and Interculturality of the Universidade Federal do Paraná(UFPR) – is a supplementary unit linked to the Humanities, Letters, and Arts sector. Created in 1995, Celin’s mission is to promote the teaching, learning, and research of various languages and cultures, including Portuguese as a foreign language, for both the UFPR community and the general public.
Celin offers a wide variety of language courses, including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Russian, Polish, Ukrainian, Hebrew, Guarani, Latin, Ancient Greek, Turkish, Norwegian, and Esperanto. It also offers courses in literature, cinema, writing, poetry, and Brazilian popular music analysis (MPB), among others.
Celin's activities are guided by an intercultural perspective, encouraging reflection on the relationships among language, culture, and identity. It also provides free courses to UFPR students, staff, and underprivileged communities, fulfilling an important social role.
Celin trains future language teachers through courses and supervised internships and offers ongoing training for current teachers. Faculty are encouraged to engage in projects such as material development, distance learning resources, and online publications.

title: English Course
description: Training completed at a school with an intensive methodology focused on achieving fluency within 2.5 years. I completed all levels offered by the institution, developing reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills according to international proficiency standards.
text:
inFlux Xaxim is a branch of the inFlux language school network, located in the Xaxim neighborhood of Curitiba. Specializing in English and Spanish instruction, the school uses its own methodology aimed at rapid language acquisition, focusing on fluency and practical use of knowledge.
InFlux Xaxim offers English and Spanish courses with contractual learning guarantees. The programs are structured to help students reach an advanced level more quickly, emphasizing practical skills for travel, exchange programs, and professional opportunities. The school also hosts cultural events and interactive activities, such as traditional celebrations and Olympic games, to enrich the learning experience.
